inventory.centralSubtitle: Shipyard equipment and material stock in one place.
inventory.byTypeHelp: Equipment with the same brand and model is grouped together. Quantity means the number of equipment records. Open a list to see individual items.
inventory.scopeHelp: Your shipyard owns its inventory. Only published equipment appears to other shipyards.
inventory.sharingHelp: The equipment type, shipyard name and sharing note below appear in the shared list. Equipment codes and private inventory fields stay private.

inventory.noTypesHelp: Add your first equipment record or import your shipyard's Excel inventory.
inventory.typeMeaning: An equipment type, such as Forklift, is a shared definition. This record represents one specific item in your shipyard.
inventory.byTypeStockHelp: Equipment shows brand and model; materials show name and stock quantity. Open details to inspect a record.
inventory.stockListHelp: Open a material to see its name, code and stock quantity. Use Actions to edit or manage sharing.
inventory.stockMeaning: For materials such as scaffold parts, one record holds the stock quantity of that material. You do not need a separate record for each piece.
inventory.stockQuantityHelp: Enter total stock quantity. This is not the amount available to other shipyards. Enter 0 when there is no stock.
inventory.stockImportHelp: Each row is one material stock record. Map material code, name and stock quantity. Reimporting the same code within the same shipyard and type updates stock quantity; it does not add to the previous amount. The workbook’s shipyard column does not assign ownership; check the selected shipyard.

home.subtitleLead: Manage shared equipment types, shipyard inventory and user access in one place.
home.subtitleDetail: Standardize technical fields and record physical equipment under its owner shipyard. Import Excel files and review existing records.
home.glance1Desc: Required fields and selection lists for each equipment type.
home.glance2Desc: Type definitions are shared; physical equipment belongs to its owner shipyard.
home.glance3Desc: Review inventory lists and download Excel files or list reports.
home.workflow1Desc: Set catalog codes, categories, preliminary sharing classes and technical fields.
home.workflow2Desc: Record each physical asset with its type, equipment code and owner shipyard.
home.workflow3Desc: Review records using type and shipyard filters, then export Excel files or list reports.
home.feature1Desc: Keep equipment codes, technical fields and owner shipyard information in one record.
home.feature2Desc: Use common definitions across shipyards while managing inventory within each account's access scope.
home.feature3Desc: Filter existing inventory and export selected-type equipment to Excel.
home.feature4Desc: Assign users to shipyards and manage platform, shipyard administrator and member roles.
home.feature5Desc: Add or update type catalogs and physical equipment from Excel workbooks.
home.feature6Desc: Email-based login flows, password policies, and optional MFA hooks aligned with modern auth practice.
home.bottomCtaDesc: Prepare the type catalog, create shipyard records and import your first equipment file.
